user.title: Set up Maintenance Planner
user.description: Manage maintenance tasks and material stock locally in Home Assistant. The planning horizon determines how far ahead the shopping list looks.

error.invalid_horizon: Enter a whole number from 0 to 365.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one maintenance planner can be configured.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: The shopping list considers minimum stock and all pending tasks due by the end of this horizon. Overdue tasks are included; tasks without a due date are excluded.

add_task.title: Add maintenance task
add_task.description: Choose a count and unit for a recurring schedule, for example every 8 weeks. The next due date is calculated from completion. A count of 0 leaves follow-up dates unscheduled.

data_description.clear_due_date: Enable to remove a previously saved due date.
data_description.interval_count: For example, choose 8 with the unit weeks. Eight weeks is 56 days.
data_description.interval_unit: Months are calendar months; month-end dates use the last valid day.
data_description.consumables: Optionally choose one or more saved materials and enter the quantity needed per occurrence.
data_description.due_date: Leave the date empty and set the interval to 0 to use the maintenance signal alone. You can also set a date alongside the signal.
data_description.use_signal: Enable to choose the entity and the triggering state in the next step.
data_description.reminder_mode: Send an early warning before the due date or when an entity reports a matching state.
data_description.reminder_push: Optionally send early warnings and due notifications to a device with the Home Assistant Companion App as push notifications.
data_description.device_id: Choose a device from Manage devices to limit signal selection to its entities. Choose No device to select from all available entities.
data_description.reminder_days: For Days before due date, enter a lead time from 1 to 365 days.
data_description.due_reminder: Send a notification when the due date arrives or the maintenance signal makes the task due.

edit_task_details.title: Edit maintenance task
edit_task_details.description: Leave the interval at 0 for a one-time task. For a recurring task, choose a count and unit, for example every 8 weeks. The next due date is calculated from completion. Assign materials and entity rules afterwards from the management menu.

data_description.clear_due_date: Enable to remove a previously saved due date.
data_description.interval_count: For example, choose 8 with the unit weeks. Eight weeks is 56 days.
data_description.interval_unit: Months are calendar months; month-end dates use the last valid day.
data_description.reminder_mode: Send an early warning before the due date or when an entity reports a matching state.
data_description.reminder_push: Optionally send early warnings and due notifications to a device with the Home Assistant Companion App as push notifications.
data_description.device_id: Choose a device from Manage devices to limit signal selection to its entities. Choose No device to select from all available entities.
data_description.reminder_days: For Days before due date, enter a lead time from 1 to 365 days.
data_description.due_reminder: Send a notification when the due date arrives or the maintenance signal makes the task due.

data_description.device_id: Optionally assign a device from Manage devices that uses this material.
data_description.purchase_url: Optional link to the supplier. Enter a full URL beginning with `https://` or `http://`.

edit_material_details.title: Edit material and stock
edit_material_details.description: Enter the total stock currently on hand. Increase it after purchasing more supplies.

data_description.device_id: Optionally assign a device from Manage devices that uses this material.
data_description.purchase_url: Optional link to the supplier. Enter a full URL beginning with `https://` or `http://`.

assign_material.title: Assign material
assign_material.description: The quantity is needed each time this maintenance task is completed. An existing requirement for the same material is replaced. Use quantity 0 to remove the assignment.

remove_material.title: Delete material
remove_material.description: A material can only be deleted after removing it from all maintenance tasks.

confirm_remove.title: Confirm deletion
confirm_remove.description: Delete “{name}”? Previously recorded completions remain in the history.

configure_trigger.title: Select maintenance task for entity rule

trigger_details.title: Entity rule for “{name}”
trigger_details.description: Make the task due when an entity state or an attribute matches the condition. Example: a salt-empty binary sensor equals `on` → refill salt. A rule that already matches takes effect immediately. `unknown` and `unavailable` are ignored. Leave attribute empty to use the entity state.

data_description.trigger_enabled: Disable to remove this rule. The time-based schedule remains.
data_description.trigger_attribute: Internal attribute name, for example operating_hours. Leave empty for the state.
data_description.trigger_value: Equals compares exact, case-sensitive text, for example on. Above and below require a number and exclude the threshold itself.

task_signals.title: Select signals
task_signals.description: An early warning can notify you when the salt supply is nearly empty. Maintenance becomes due on the optional date or when the maintenance signal matches, for example when the salt supply is empty.

data_description.trigger_entity_id: Optionally select an entity, such as the binary sensor that reports an empty salt supply on a BWT system. A matching state makes the task due.
data_description.trigger_value: The entity’s raw state must match exactly. The default is `on`, as used by binary sensors.
data_description.reminder_entity_id: Choose the entity that provides the early warning, for example the BWT sensor for a nearly empty salt supply.
data_description.reminder_value: The entity’s raw state must match exactly. The default is `on`, as used by binary sensors.

manage_devices.title: Manage devices
manage_devices.description: The devices selected here are available when assigning maintenance tasks and materials.

error.invalid_input: The data is invalid. Check the values and try again.
error.material_in_use: This material is still assigned to a task. Remove its requirements first using Assign material with quantity 0.
error.not_found: This entry was deleted. Reopen the management dialog.
error.storage_error: The change could not be saved. Try again and check the Home Assistant log if needed.
error.invalid_interval_count: Enter a whole number from 0 to 36500.
error.invalid_horizon: Enter a whole number from 0 to 365.
error.entity_required: Select an entity for the enabled rule.
error.value_required: Provide a comparison value. For an empty state, explicitly use empty text.
error.invalid_rule: The rule is invalid. Check the entity, comparison and value. Numeric comparisons require a finite number.
error.duplicate_consumable: Select each consumable once and enter the total quantity needed.
error.invalid_consumable: Choose saved materials and enter a valid quantity greater than zero for each one.
error.signal_device_has_no_entities: This device has no enabled entities. Choose another device or leave the device selection empty.
error.signal_entity_unavailable: Choose an available entity from the list.
error.device_in_use: At least one removed device is still assigned to a maintenance task or material. Change its assignments first.
error.device_unavailable: Choose an available device from the list.
error.invalid_purchase_url: Enter a full web address beginning with https:// or http://.
error.invalid_reminder_days: Enter a whole number from 1 to 365.

abort.not_loaded: The integration is not loaded. Reload it and try again.
abort.no_tasks: There are no maintenance tasks yet.
abort.not_found: The selected entry no longer exists.
abort.signal_device_unavailable: The selected device no longer has any available entities. Reopen the form and choose an available device.

upsert_material.name: Create or update material
upsert_material.description: Set inventory data. Leave the material ID empty to create a material. Returns its ID when response data is requested.

material_id.name: Material ID
material_id.description: Existing ID from get_plan. Leave empty to create a material.

stock.name: Stock
stock.description: Current stock in the selected unit. Omit to keep the existing value.

min_stock.name: Minimum stock
min_stock.description: Minimum stock to keep in the selected unit.

unit.name: Unit
unit.description: Unit used for stock and consumption quantities, for example pcs or liters.

remove_material.name: Remove material
remove_material.description: Delete a material after removing all its assignments to maintenance tasks.

material_id.name: Material ID
material_id.description: ID of the material to delete, as returned by get_plan.

adjust_stock.name: Adjust stock
adjust_stock.description: Add received materials or apply a signed inventory correction. Stock cannot become negative.

material_id.name: Material ID
material_id.description: ID of the material to change, as returned by get_plan.

quantity.name: Quantity to add or subtract
quantity.description: Positive quantities add stock; negative quantities subtract it.

upsert_task.name: Create or update maintenance
upsert_task.description: Set a maintenance task, its material requirements and an optional entity rule. Leave the task ID empty to create a task. Intervals use days, weeks or calendar months.

task_id.name: Task ID
task_id.description: Existing ID from get_plan. Leave empty to create a maintenance task.

name.name: Name
name.description: Display name of the maintenance task.

due_date.name: Due date
due_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD. In YAML, use null to clear the date.

interval_days.name: Repeat after days
interval_days.description: Days from completion. Set to zero for no day interval.

interval_months.name: Repeat after calendar months
interval_months.description: Months from completion. Set to zero for no month interval.

requirements.name: Material requirements
requirements.description: Mapping of material IDs to quantities per maintenance occurrence. Replaces all existing assignments.

description.name: Description
description.description: Optional instructions or notes for performing the maintenance task.

interval_weeks.name: Repeat after weeks
interval_weeks.description: Number of weeks from completion. Eight weeks is 56 days. Set to zero for no week interval.

trigger.name: Entity rule
trigger.description: Object with entity_id, optional attribute, operator (equals, above or below), and value as text. A matching condition makes the task due. In YAML, use null to remove the rule.

remove_task.name: Remove maintenance
remove_task.description: Delete a task. Previous completions remain in the history.

task_id.name: Task ID
task_id.description: ID of the maintenance task to delete, as returned by get_plan.

complete_task.name: Complete maintenance
complete_task.description: Consume assigned materials and schedule the next occurrence. Fails without changing stock if materials are missing.

task_id.name: Task ID
task_id.description: ID of the maintenance task to complete, as returned by get_plan.

expected_generation.name: Occurrence number
expected_generation.description: Optional generation from get_plan. Prevents duplicate consumption when retrying an automation.

reopen_task.name: Reopen maintenance
reopen_task.description: Reopen a completed one-off task. Consumed material is not restored; correct inventory separately when necessary.

task_id.name: Task ID
task_id.description: ID of the completed one-time task to reopen, as returned by get_plan.

get_plan.name: Get plan and inventory
get_plan.description: Return materials, tasks with IDs and occurrence numbers, the latest 1000 completions, and the current shopping needs.
